verses.original: Γνωρίζομεν δὲ ὑμῖν ἀδελφοί τὴν χάριν τοῦ Θεοῦ τὴν δεδομένην ἐν ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῆς Μακεδονίας
verses.transliteration: Gnōrizomen de hymin adelphoi tēn charin tou Theou tēn dedomenēn en tais ekklēsiais tēs Makedonias
verses.literal: Now brothers we want you to know about . . . the grace that God has given . . . the churches of Macedonia
verses.literalPt: Além disso, irmãos, vos fazemos conhecer a graça de Deus, que foi dada nas igrejas da Macedônia;

verses.original: ὅτι ἐν πολλῇ δοκιμῇ θλίψεως ἡ περισσεία τῆς χαρᾶς αὐτῶν καὶ ἡ κατὰ βάθους πτωχεία αὐτῶν ἐπερίσσευσεν εἰς τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς ἁπλότητος αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: hoti en pollē dokimē thlipseōs hē perisseia tēs charas autōn kai hē kata bathous ptōcheia autōn eperisseusen eis to ploutos tēs haplotētos autōn
verses.literal: In the terrible ordeal they suffered - their abundant joy and deep - poverty overflowed into rich generosity
verses.literalPt: como, em grande prova de tribulação, a abundância do seu gozo e a sua extrema pobreza abundaram nas riquezas da sua generosidade;

verses.original: ὅτι κατὰ δύναμιν μαρτυρῶ καὶ παρὰ δύναμιν αὐθαίρετοι
verses.transliteration: hoti kata dynamin martyrō kai para dynamin authairetoi
verses.literal: For I testify that they gave according to their ability and even beyond it Of their own accord
verses.literalPt: porque testifico que, segundo as suas forças e além das suas forças, contribuíram espontaneamente,

verses.original: μετὰ πολλῆς παρακλήσεως δεόμενοι ἡμῶν τὴν χάριν καὶ τὴν κοινωνίαν τῆς διακονίας τῆς εἰς τοὺς ἁγίους
verses.transliteration: meta pollēs paraklēseōs deomenoi hēmōn tēn charin kai tēn koinōnian tēs diakonias tēs eis tous hagious
verses.literal: they earnestly pleaded with us for the privilege - of sharing in this service to the saints
verses.literalPt: pedindo-nos, com muitas súplicas, o favor de se associarem nesse serviço pelos santos.

verses.original: καὶ οὐ καθὼς ἠλπίσαμεν ἀλλ’ ἑαυτοὺς ἔδωκαν πρῶτον τῷ Κυρίῳ καὶ ἡμῖν διὰ θελήματος Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ou kathōs ēlpisamen all’ heautous edōkan prōton tō Kyriō kai hēmin dia thelēmatos Theou
verses.literal: And not only did they do as we expected but they gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us through the will of God
verses.literalPt: Eles não só fizeram como esperávamos, mas deram-se a si mesmos primeiro ao Senhor, depois a nós, pela vontade de Deus;

verses.original: Εἰς τὸ παρακαλέσαι ἡμᾶς Τίτον ἵνα καθὼς προενήρξατο οὕτως καὶ ἐπιτελέσῃ εἰς ὑμᾶς καὶ τὴν χάριν ταύτην
verses.transliteration: Eis to parakalesai hēmas Titon hina kathōs proenērxato houtōs kai epitelesē eis hymas kai tēn charin tautēn
verses.literal: So we urged Titus - to help complete your act of grace just as he had started it
verses.literalPt: de maneira que exortamos a Tito a que, como antes ele tinha começado, assim também completasse em vós ainda esta graça.

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ὥσπερ ἐν παντὶ περισσεύετε πίστει καὶ λόγῳ καὶ γνώσει καὶ πάσῃ σπουδῇ καὶ τῇ ἐξ ἡμῶν ἐν ὑμῖν ἀγάπῃ ἵνα καὶ ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ χάριτι περισσεύητε
verses.transliteration: all’ hōsper en panti perisseuete pistei kai logō kai gnōsei kai pasē spoudē kai tē ex hēmōn en hymin agapē hina kai en tautē tē chariti perisseuēte
verses.literal: But just as you excel in everything in faith in speech in knowledge in complete earnestness and in the love we inspired in you see that you also excel . . . in this grace of giving
verses.literalPt: Mas, como abundais em tudo, em fé, em palavra, em ciência, em toda a solicitude, em nosso amor para convosco, vede que assim abundeis também nessa graça.

verses.original: Οὐ κατ’ ἐπιταγὴν λέγω ἀλλὰ διὰ τῆς ἑτέρων σπουδῆς καὶ τὸ τῆς ὑμετέρας ἀγάπης γνήσιον δοκιμάζων
verses.transliteration: Ou kat’ epitagēn legō alla dia tēs heterōn spoudēs kai to tēs hymeteras agapēs gnēsion dokimazōn
verses.literal: I am not giving a command but I am testing the sincerity of your love through the earnestness of others
verses.literalPt: Não o digo como mandamento, mas para provar, mediante o zelo de outros, a sinceridade também da vossa caridade;

verses.original: Γινώσκετε γὰρ τὴν χάριν τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ὅτι δι’ ὑμᾶς ἐπτώχευσεν πλούσιος ὤν ἵνα ὑμεῖς τῇ ἐκείνου πτωχείᾳ πλουτήσητε
verses.transliteration: Ginōskete gar tēn charin tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou hoti di’ hymas eptōcheusen plousios ōn hina hymeis tē ekeinou ptōcheia ploutēsēte
verses.literal: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ that though He was rich yet for your sake . . . He became poor so that you through His poverty might become rich
verses.literalPt: pois conheceis a graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, que, sendo rico, se tornou pobre por amor de vós, para que pela sua pobreza fôsseis vós enriquecidos.

verses.original: καὶ γνώμην ἐν τούτῳ δίδωμι τοῦτο γὰρ ὑμῖν συμφέρει οἵτινες οὐ μόνον τὸ ποιῆσαι ἀλλὰ καὶ τὸ θέλειν προενήρξασθε ἀπὸ πέρυσι
verses.transliteration: kai gnōmēn en toutō didōmi touto gar hymin sympherei hoitines ou monon to poiēsai alla kai to thelein proenērxasthe apo perysi
verses.literal: And this is my opinion . . . about what is helpful for you in this matter Last year you were the first not only to give but even to have such a desire
verses.literalPt: Nisso dou o meu parecer; pois é para o proveito de vós que primeiro começastes, desde o ano passado, não só a fazer, mas também a querer.

verses.original: νυνὶ δὲ καὶ τὸ ποιῆσαι ἐπιτελέσατε ὅπως καθάπερ ἡ προθυμία τοῦ θέλειν οὕτως καὶ τὸ ἐπιτελέσαι ἐκ τοῦ ἔχειν
verses.transliteration: nyni de kai to poiēsai epitelesate hopōs kathaper hē prothymia tou thelein houtōs kai to epitelesai ek tou echein
verses.literal: Now . . . . . . finish the work so that you may complete it with the same eager desire . . . . . . according to your means
verses.literalPt: Agora, porém, acabai a obra, para que, como houve prontidão no querer, assim também haja o cumprir segundo as vossas posses.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ ἡ προθυμία πρόκειται καθὸ ἐὰν ἔχῃ εὐπρόσδεκτος οὐ καθὸ οὐκ ἔχει
verses.transliteration: ei gar hē prothymia prokeitai katho ean echē euprosdektos ou katho ouk echei
verses.literal: For if the eagerness is there the gift is acceptable according to what one has not according to what he does not have
verses.literalPt: Se existe a prontidão, é aceitável segundo o que alguém tem e não segundo o que não tem.

verses.original: Οὐ γὰρ ἵνα ἄλλοις ἄνεσις ὑμῖν θλῖψις ἀλλ’ ἐξ ἰσότητος
verses.transliteration: Ou gar hina allois anesis hymin thlipsis all’ ex isotētos
verses.literal: It is not our intention . . . that others may be relieved while you are burdened but that there may be equality
verses.literalPt: Pois digo isso, não para que haja alívio para outros e aperto, para vós;

verses.original: ἐν τῷ νῦν καιρῷ τὸ ὑμῶν περίσσευμα εἰς τὸ ἐκείνων ὑστέρημα ἵνα καὶ τὸ ἐκείνων περίσσευμα γένηται εἰς τὸ ὑμῶν ὑστέρημα ὅπως γένηται ἰσότης
verses.transliteration: en tō nyn kairō to hymōn perisseuma eis to ekeinōn hysterēma hina kai to ekeinōn perisseuma genētai eis to hymōn hysterēma hopōs genētai isotēs
verses.literal: At the present time your surplus will meet their need so that in turn their surplus will meet your need This way there will be equality
verses.literalPt: mas para que haja igualdade, suprindo a vossa abundância no tempo presente a sua deficiência, para que também a sua abundância venha a suprir a vossa deficiência, a fim de que haja igualdade,

verses.original: καθὼς γέγραπται Ὁ τὸ πολὺ οὐκ ἐπλεόνασεν καὶ ὁ τὸ ὀλίγον οὐκ ἠλαττόνησεν
verses.transliteration: kathōs gegraptai Ho to poly ouk epleonasen kai ho to oligon ouk ēlattonēsen
verses.literal: As it is written He who gathered much had no excess and he who gathered little had no shortfall
verses.literalPt: como está escrito: O que muito colheu não teve sobra; e o que pouco colheu não teve falta.

verses.original: Χάρις δὲ τῷ Θεῷ τῷ διδόντι τὴν αὐτὴν σπουδὴν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ Τίτου
verses.transliteration: Charis de tō Theō tō didonti tēn autēn spoudēn hyper hymōn en tē kardia Titou
verses.literal: But thanks be to God who put into the heart of Titus the same devotion I have for you
verses.literalPt: Mas, graças a Deus, que pôs no coração de Tito a mesma solicitude por vós;

verses.original: ὅτι τὴν μὲν παράκλησιν ἐδέξατο σπουδαιότερος δὲ ὑπάρχων αὐθαίρετος ἐξῆλθεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: hoti tēn men paraklēsin edexato spoudaioteros de hyparchōn authairetos exēlthen pros hymas
verses.literal: For not only did he welcome our appeal but he is eagerly coming to you of his own volition
verses.literalPt: porque, com efeito, aceitou a nossa exortação, porém, sendo mais zeloso, partiu para vós por sua própria vontade.

verses.original: Συνεπέμψαμεν δὲ μετ’ αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀδελφὸν οὗ ὁ ἔπαινος ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ διὰ πασῶν τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν
verses.transliteration: Synepempsamen de met’ autou ton adelphon hou ho epainos en tō euangeliō dia pasōn tōn ekklēsiōn
verses.literal: Along with Titus we are sending the brother who is praised by all the churches for his work in the gospel
verses.literalPt: Enviamos juntamente com ele o irmão cujo louvor no evangelho se tem espalhado em todas as igrejas,

verses.original: οὐ μόνον δὲ ἀλλὰ καὶ χειροτονηθεὶς ὑπὸ τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν συνέκδημος ἡμῶν σὺν τῇ χάριτι ταύτῃ τῇ διακονουμένῃ ὑφ’ ἡμῶν πρὸς τὴν αὐτοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου δόξαν καὶ προθυμίαν ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: ou monon de alla kai cheirotonētheis hypo tōn ekklēsiōn synekdēmos hēmōn syn tē chariti tautē tē diakonoumenē hyph’ hēmōn pros tēn autou tou Kyriou doxan kai prothymian hēmōn
verses.literal: More than that . . . . . . . . . . . . this brother was chosen by the churches to accompany us with the gracious offering - we administer to honor the Lord Himself and to show our eagerness to help
verses.literalPt: e não somente isso, mas também foi pelas igrejas eleito nosso companheiro de viagem no tocante a esta graça administrada por nós, para a própria glória do Senhor e para mostrar a nossa boa vontade;

verses.original: στελλόμενοι τοῦτο μή τις ἡμᾶς μωμήσηται ἐν τῇ ἁδρότητι ταύτῃ τῇ διακονουμένῃ ὑφ’ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: stellomenoi touto mē tis hēmas mōmēsētai en tē hadrotēti tautē tē diakonoumenē hyph’ hēmōn
verses.literal: We want to avoid - any criticism of the way we administer this generous gift
verses.literalPt: evitando que alguém nos censure a propósito dessa abundância que por nós é ministrada;

verses.original: προνοοῦμεν γὰρ καλὰ οὐ μόνον ἐνώπιον Κυρίου ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐνώπιον ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: pronooumen gar kala ou monon enōpion Kyriou alla kai enōpion anthrōpōn
verses.literal: For we are taking great care to do what is right not only in the eyes of the Lord but also in the eyes of men
verses.literalPt: pois cuidamos de prover coisas honrosas, não só perante o Senhor, como também perante os homens.

verses.original: Συνεπέμψαμεν δὲ αὐτοῖς τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν ὃν ἐδοκιμάσαμεν ἐν πολλοῖς πολλάκις σπουδαῖον ὄντα νυνὶ δὲ πολὺ σπουδαιότερον πεποιθήσει πολλῇ τῇ εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Synepempsamen de autois ton adelphon hēmōn hon edokimasamen en pollois pollakis spoudaion onta nyni de poly spoudaioteron pepoithēsei pollē tē eis hymas
verses.literal: And we are sending along with them our brother who has proven his earnestness to us many times and in many ways and now even more so by his great confidence in you
verses.literalPt: Enviamos com eles um nosso irmão que em muitas coisas temos provado muitas vezes ser zeloso, mas agora muito mais zeloso pela muita confiança que tem em vós.

verses.original: εἴτε ὑπὲρ Τίτου κοινωνὸς ἐμὸς καὶ εἰς ὑμᾶς συνεργός εἴτε ἀδελφοὶ ἡμῶν ἀπόστολοι ἐκκλησιῶν δόξα Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: eite hyper Titou koinōnos emos kai eis hymas synergos eite adelphoi hēmōn apostoloi ekklēsiōn doxa Christou
verses.literal: As for . . . Titus he is my partner and fellow worker among you As for our brothers they are messengers of the churches the glory of Christ
verses.literalPt: Se alguém perguntar quanto a Tito, ele é meu companheiro e cooperador para convosco; quanto aos nossos irmãos, são mensageiros das igrejas, glória de Cristo.

verses.original: τὴν οὖν ἔνδειξιν τῆς ἀγάπης ὑμῶν καὶ ἡμῶν καυχήσεως ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν εἰς αὐτοὺς ἐνδεικνύμενοι εἰς πρόσωπον τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν
verses.transliteration: tēn oun endeixin tēs agapēs hymōn kai hēmōn kauchēseōs hyper hymōn eis autous endeiknymenoi eis prosōpon tōn ekklēsiōn
verses.literal: In full view of the churches then show these men the proof of your love and the reason for our boasting about you
verses.literalPt: Dai-lhes, portanto, diante das igrejas, prova do vosso amor e da nossa glória a vosso respeito.
